data.hint: Not a module or prebuilt container. Python packages come from python-sci/python-ml or a uv/Pixi env; anything on Docker Hub runs with apptainer (docker://image:tag). See install_tools in recipes.
data.how_to_load: module load <name>[/<version>]; MPI-built packages appear after `module load openmpi` (or mpich / intel-oneapi-mpi). Compilers: gcc/13.5.0 is the default toolchain of the Spack stack. `module spider <name>` shows how to reach any module.
